CREATE TRIGGER r34_event_apply AFTER INSERT ON followup_task_events WHEN NEW.kind<>'created'
        BEGIN UPDATE followup_tasks SET gym_id=NEW.gym_id,client_id=NEW.client_id,cause=NEW.cause,cause_evidence_hash=NEW.cause_evidence_hash,observed_at=NEW.observed_at,plan_count=NEW.plan_count,last_plan_at=NEW.last_plan_at,membership_end=NEW.membership_end,priority_at_creation=NEW.priority_at_creation,next_step=NEW.next_step,assignee_id=NEW.assignee_id,status=NEW.status,version=NEW.version,created_by=NEW.created_by,created_at=NEW.created_at,updated_at=NEW.updated_at,completed_by=NEW.completed_by,completed_at=NEW.completed_at,outcome=NEW.outcome,cancelled_by=NEW.cancelled_by,cancelled_at=NEW.cancelled_at,cancel_reason=NEW.cancel_reason,current_event_id=NEW.id WHERE id=NEW.task_id AND gym_id=NEW.gym_id; END

CREATE TRIGGER r34_event_authorize BEFORE INSERT ON followup_task_events BEGIN
        SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios a JOIN usuarios g ON g.id=NEW.gym_id
        WHERE a.id=NEW.actor_id AND a.activo AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.invitation_token IS NULL
        AND a.session_version BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 AND a.session_version=CAST(a.session_version AS INTEGER)
        AND lower(a.role) = NEW.actor_role AND g.activo AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND g.session_version BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 AND g.session_version=CAST(g.session_version AS INTEGER)
        AND g.invitation_token IS NULL AND g.tipo='gym' AND g.role='OWNER' AND g.team_gym_id IS NULL
        AND ((a.id=g.id AND a.role='OWNER' AND a.tipo='gym' AND a.team_gym_id IS NULL)
          OR (a.team_gym_id=g.id AND a.role IN ('ADMIN','NUTRIOLOGO'))))) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up actor denied') END;
        SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.kind<>'cancelled' AND NOT ((NEW.assignee_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios a WHERE a.id=NEW.assignee_id
        AND a.activo AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.invitation_token IS NULL
        AND a.session_version BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 AND a.session_version=CAST(a.session_version AS INTEGER)
        AND ((a.id=NEW.gym_id AND a.role='OWNER' AND a.tipo='gym' AND a.team_gym_id IS NULL)
          OR (a.team_gym_id=NEW.gym_id AND a.role IN ('ADMIN','NUTRIOLOGO')))))) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up assignee denied') END;
        SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clientes WHERE id_cliente=NEW.client_id AND gym_id=NEW.gym_id AND activo AND deleted_at IS NULL)
            THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up client denied') END;
        SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (((NEW.kind='created' AND NEW.version=1 AND NEW.status='open' AND NEW.created_by=NEW.actor_id
        AND NEW.created_at=NEW.updated_at AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM followup_tasks t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id))
        OR (NEW.kind<>'created' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM followup_tasks t WHERE t.id=NEW.task_id
          AND t.gym_id=NEW.gym_id AND t.status='open' AND t.version<2147483647 AND NEW.version=t.version+1
          AND ((NEW.kind='updated' AND NEW.status='open' AND (NEW.next_step<>t.next_step OR NEW.assignee_id IS NOT t.assignee_id))
            OR (NEW.kind='completed' AND NEW.status='completed' AND NEW.completed_by=NEW.actor_id
                AND NEW.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.assignee_id=t.assignee_id AND NEW.next_step=t.next_step)
            OR (NEW.kind='cancelled' AND NEW.status='cancelled' AND NEW.cancelled_by=NEW.actor_id
                AND NEW.assignee_id IS t.assignee_id AND NEW.next_step=t.next_step)))))) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up transition denied') END;
        SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.kind='created' AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clientes c WHERE c.id_cliente=NEW.client_id AND c.gym_id=NEW.gym_id
        AND c.activo AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.fecha_fin_suscripcion IS NEW.membership_end)
        AND NEW.plan_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM planes_generados p WHERE p.gym_id=NEW.gym_id
            AND p.id_cliente=NEW.client_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL)
        AND NEW.last_plan_at IS (SELECT max(p.fecha_generacion) FROM planes_generados p
            WHERE p.gym_id=NEW.gym_id AND p.id_cliente=NEW.client_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL)) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up source changed') END;
        SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.kind='created' AND NOT (((NEW.cause='no_saved_plan' AND NEW.plan_count=0)
        OR (NEW.cause='plan_date_missing' AND NEW.plan_count>0 AND NEW.last_plan_at IS NULL)
        OR (NEW.cause='no_plan_in_window' AND NEW.plan_count>0 AND NEW.last_plan_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.last_plan_at<strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now','-30 days'))
        OR (NEW.cause='membership_date_passed' AND NEW.membership_end IS NOT NULL AND NEW.membership_end<strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now')))) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up cause absent') END;
        SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.actor_role='nutriologo' AND (NEW.kind<>'completed' OR NEW.assignee_id IS NOT NEW.actor_id)
            THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up assigned operation denied') END;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER r34_task_insert BEFORE INSERT ON followup_tasks BEGIN
        SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.version<>1 OR NEW.status<>'open' OR NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM followup_task_events e WHERE e.id=NEW.current_event_id AND e.task_id=NEW.id AND e.gym_id IS NEW.gym_id AND e.client_id IS NEW.client_id AND e.cause IS NEW.cause AND e.cause_evidence_hash IS NEW.cause_evidence_hash AND e.observed_at IS NEW.observed_at AND e.plan_count IS NEW.plan_count AND e.last_plan_at IS NEW.last_plan_at AND e.membership_end IS NEW.membership_end AND e.priority_at_creation IS NEW.priority_at_creation AND e.next_step IS NEW.next_step AND e.assignee_id IS NEW.assignee_id AND e.status IS NEW.status AND e.version IS NEW.version AND e.created_by IS NEW.created_by AND e.created_at IS NEW.created_at AND e.updated_at IS NEW.updated_at AND e.completed_by IS NEW.completed_by AND e.completed_at IS NEW.completed_at AND e.outcome IS NEW.outcome AND e.cancelled_by IS NEW.cancelled_by AND e.cancelled_at IS NEW.cancelled_at AND e.cancel_reason IS NEW.cancel_reason))
            THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up projection requires exact event') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER r34_task_update BEFORE UPDATE ON followup_tasks BEGIN
        SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.status<>'open' OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1 OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at OR NOT (NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.gym_id IS OLD.gym_id AND NEW.client_id IS OLD.client_id AND NEW.cause IS OLD.cause AND NEW.cause_evidence_hash IS OLD.cause_evidence_hash AND NEW.observed_at IS OLD.observed_at AND NEW.plan_count IS OLD.plan_count AND NEW.last_plan_at IS OLD.last_plan_at AND NEW.membership_end IS OLD.membership_end AND NEW.priority_at_creation IS OLD.priority_at_creation AND NEW.created_by IS OLD.created_by AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at)
            OR NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM followup_task_events e WHERE e.id=NEW.current_event_id AND e.task_id=NEW.id AND e.gym_id IS NEW.gym_id AND e.client_id IS NEW.client_id AND e.cause IS NEW.cause AND e.cause_evidence_hash IS NEW.cause_evidence_hash AND e.observed_at IS NEW.observed_at AND e.plan_count IS NEW.plan_count AND e.last_plan_at IS NEW.last_plan_at AND e.membership_end IS NEW.membership_end AND e.priority_at_creation IS NEW.priority_at_creation AND e.next_step IS NEW.next_step AND e.assignee_id IS NEW.assignee_id AND e.status IS NEW.status AND e.version IS NEW.version AND e.created_by IS NEW.created_by AND e.created_at IS NEW.created_at AND e.updated_at IS NEW.updated_at AND e.completed_by IS NEW.completed_by AND e.completed_at IS NEW.completed_at AND e.outcome IS NEW.outcome AND e.cancelled_by IS NEW.cancelled_by AND e.cancelled_at IS NEW.cancelled_at AND e.cancel_reason IS NEW.cancel_reason)) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'Follow-up projection is immutable') END; END

CREATE TRIGGER r36_fact_insert BEFORE INSERT ON notification_billing_facts WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios WHERE id=NEW.user_id AND activo AND deleted_at IS NULL AND invitation_token IS NULL AND session_version BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios u WHERE u.id=NEW.user_id AND ((NEW.context='gym' AND u.tipo='gym' AND u.role='OWNER' AND u.team_gym_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.context='personal' AND u.role IN ('ADMIN','NUTRIOLOGO','VIEWER') AND (u.tipo='usuario' OR u.team_gym_id IS NOT NULL) AND (u.team_gym_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios p WHERE p.id=u.team_gym_id AND p.activo AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.invitation_token IS NULL AND p.tipo='gym' AND p.role='OWNER' AND p.team_gym_id IS NULL))))) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM provider_subject_associations a JOIN subscriptions s ON s.id=NEW.subscription_id AND s.gym_id=NEW.user_id AND s.provider=NEW.provider WHERE a.provider=NEW.provider AND a.resource_type=NEW.resource_type AND a.resource_id=NEW.resource_id AND a.subject_id=NEW.user_id AND ((NEW.provider='stripe' AND NEW.resource_type='subscription' AND s.stripe_subscription_id=NEW.resource_id) OR (NEW.provider='mercadopago' AND NEW.resource_type='payment' AND s.provider_payment_id=NEW.resource_id))) OR NEW.version<>COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM notification_billing_facts WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND context=NEW.context),0)+1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Notification fact source denied'); END

CREATE TRIGGER r36_outbox_insert BEFORE INSERT ON notification_outbox WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios WHERE id=NEW.user_id AND activo AND deleted_at IS NULL AND invitation_token IS NULL AND session_version BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios u WHERE u.id=NEW.user_id AND ((NEW.context='gym' AND u.tipo='gym' AND u.role='OWNER' AND u.team_gym_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.context='personal' AND u.role IN ('ADMIN','NUTRIOLOGO','VIEWER') AND (u.tipo='usuario' OR u.team_gym_id IS NOT NULL) AND (u.team_gym_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios p WHERE p.id=u.team_gym_id AND p.activo AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.invitation_token IS NULL AND p.tipo='gym' AND p.role='OWNER' AND p.team_gym_id IS NULL))))) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notification_preferences p JOIN notification_billing_facts f ON f.id=NEW.fact_id AND f.user_id=p.user_id AND f.context=p.context JOIN usuarios u ON u.id=p.user_id AND u.notification_contact_version=p.contact_version WHERE p.id=NEW.preference_id AND p.user_id=NEW.user_id AND p.context=NEW.context AND p.purpose=NEW.purpose AND p.enabled AND p.contact_hash=NEW.contact_hash AND p.contact_version=NEW.contact_version AND f.source_hash=NEW.source_hash AND p.version=(SELECT max(x.version) FROM notification_preferences x WHERE x.user_id=p.user_id AND x.context=p.context AND x.purpose=p.purpose)) OR NEW.state<>'pending' OR NEW.version<>1 OR NEW.attempt_count<>0 OR NEW.lease_hash IS NOT NULL OR NEW.lease_until IS NOT NULL OR NEW.sending_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.exclude_hash IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Notification outbox source denied'); END

CREATE TRIGGER r36_outbox_update BEFORE UPDATE ON notification_outbox WHEN NOT (NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.user_id IS OLD.user_id AND NEW.context IS OLD.context AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at AND NEW.purpose IS OLD.purpose AND NEW.channel IS OLD.channel AND NEW.preference_id IS OLD.preference_id AND NEW.fact_id IS OLD.fact_id AND NEW.source_hash IS OLD.source_hash AND NEW.contact_hash IS OLD.contact_hash AND NEW.contact_version IS OLD.contact_version AND NEW.request_key IS OLD.request_key AND NEW.request_hash IS OLD.request_hash) OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1 OR NOT ((OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state IN ('leased','suppressed')) OR (OLD.state='leased' AND NEW.state IN ('leased','sending','retry_wait','suppressed')) OR (OLD.state='sending' AND NEW.state IN ('accepted','retry_wait','failed','uncertain')) OR (OLD.state='retry_wait' AND NEW.state IN ('leased','suppressed')) OR (OLD.state='uncertain' AND NEW.state IN ('suppressed'))) OR NEW.attempt_count<>OLD.attempt_count+CASE WHEN NEW.state='sending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Notification state transition denied'); END

CREATE TRIGGER r36_preference_insert BEFORE INSERT ON notification_preferences WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios WHERE id=NEW.user_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND invitation_token IS NULL AND session_version BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647 AND notification_contact_version=NEW.contact_version AND (NOT NEW.enabled OR activo)) OR NEW.version<>COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM notification_preferences WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND context=NEW.context AND purpose=NEW.purpose),0)+1 OR (NEW.enabled AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios u WHERE u.id=NEW.user_id AND ((NEW.context='gym' AND u.tipo='gym' AND u.role='OWNER' AND u.team_gym_id IS NULL) OR (NEW.context='personal' AND u.role IN ('ADMIN','NUTRIOLOGO','VIEWER') AND (u.tipo='usuario' OR u.team_gym_id IS NOT NULL) AND (u.team_gym_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM usuarios p WHERE p.id=u.team_gym_id AND p.activo AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.invitation_token IS NULL AND p.tipo='gym' AND p.role='OWNER' AND p.team_gym_id IS NULL)))))) OR (NOT NEW.enabled AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notification_preferences WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id AND context=NEW.context AND purpose=NEW.purpose)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Notification preference scope denied'); END
